Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational skills, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: hows among others, which: - start a conversation (Right, Now...) 1. Why does the proper articulation of sounds matter?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. collaboratively recite poems or form minimal pairs with the sounds / ə /, /ɑ: / and / ɜ: / Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.

2. select and group words from newspapers, magazines, online texts, radio programmes, news bulletins, television shows among others, which: - start a conversation (Right, Now...) 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collaboratively recite poems or form minimal pairs with the sounds / ə /, /ɑ: / and / ɜ: / Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.
2. select and group words from newspapers, magazines, online texts, radio programmes, news bulletins, television shows among others, which: - start a conversation (Right, Now...) 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn as a learner carries out research as they look for examples of idea connectors in books or the internet.

● Self-efficacy as a learner displays attention to detail as they watch a video and note how speakers start, end or change a

topic during a conversation.

Values:
● Patriotism is enhanced as a learner exercises dedication when they collaboratively practise changing a topic and

ordering ideas during mock speeches.

26

● Unity is promoted as learner avoids discrimination as they collaboratively recite poems or form minimal pairs with the

sounds / ə /, /ɑ: / and / ɜ: /.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

connectors to recount events in a story on the environment.
